english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a sudden brief fright or shock.
Use 一驚 for the brief involuntary jerk or fright caused by surprise.

examples.english: I got a fright when I opened the door and a dog startled me.
examples.traditional: 我一開門就俾隻狗嚇咗一驚。
